name: HISTORICAL Sidewalk Café Licenses and Applications
description:
This dataset contains historical records of sidewalk café licenses and license applications, likely from a municipal licensing agency. Each row represents a single license or application and combines business identity, location, and licensing details. There are 324 sampled rows and 47 columns.

Key fields include the license number and status, business name, and street address components (building, street, city, state, ZIP). Physical details of the café setup are captured for both the license and the application, such as café type, square footage, number of tables, and number of chairs. Geographic fields include coordinates, community district, and city council district.

The dataset also tracks the application workflow through dated milestones, including submission, intake, package sending, community board and public hearing steps, and final issuance, along with application status and expiration dates. This makes it useful for analyzing licensing timelines, comparing approved versus pending or denied applications, examining the size and type of sidewalk cafés across neighborhoods, and studying how applications move through review stages.
